title: External Source Metadata
description: Metadata for an external source tracked by HarnessKit.

source_id.description: Unique identifier for the source. Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only. Must start with a letter.

url.description: Canonical URL for the source (repository, website, or document URL)

ref.description: Git ref to track (branch name, tag, or commit-ish). Used when kind is 'git'.

observed_commit.description: The commit SHA or version identifier observed at last sync

snapshot_id.description: Identifier of the snapshot taken from this source at last sync

snapshot_path.description: Relative path within the HarnessKit repo where the snapshot is stored

content_hash.description: Hash of the observed content for detecting changes

license.description: SPDX license identifier or license name

tags.description: Arbitrary tags for categorization and filtering
